releases.name: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Edition
releases.summary:
Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in the Beans & Alpacas Expansion: Travel to Catuaí, a South America-inspired region where coffee plantations cover rolling hills, red soil shapes the land and dense greenery stretches across lower mountain slopes. New crops, animals, production chains and more than 25 new machines await.

Catuaí: Welcome to South America!

Explore a lush, humid valley with narrow roads, dusty streets, scattered rocks and a winding river running through the landscape. A small rural town with colorful buildings, shops and agricultural depots connects the region, while stilt houses line the river shore.

Coffee, Animals & New Gameplay

Cultivate coffee beans as a new crop and expand your livestock with alpacas and Brahman cows. Alpacas add new hands-on interaction through shearing and leading, while wild animals like crocodiles and parrots bring more life to the environment.

Productions, Projects & Collectibles

Create new products such as pigment and resin, and repaint houses for the community, or start production chains for crop processing. Take on the Research Center construction project, find dinosaur skeleton parts and collect your discoveries in the collectible museum.

Machines, Brands & Details

Operate 25+ new machines from Case IH, Ford, John Deere, KUHN, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, New Holland, Valtra, and many more. Colombo Industries joins the series as a new brand, while enhanced ground tool animations and improved effects increase immersion.

releases.name: Village in the Shade
releases.summary: Quiet countryside living…as long as you follow the rules. Welcome to Kagatsu, a Japanese mountain village with plenty of secrets. In this brand-new, hand-painted farming sim, you'll plant crops, customize your homestead, and meet a cast of intriguing characters—all with something to hide. Enjoy quiet countryside living...as long as you follow the rules.

releases.name: The Seance of Blake Manor
releases.summary: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

releases.name: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
releases.summary: Something has made a spectacular mess of this cozy Halloween shop. Put pumpkins, potions and sweets back where they belong, uncover curious clues, and meet a mysterious new friend. A relaxing first-person tidy-up, with a little mischief.

releases.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
releases.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

releases.name: Treasure Tiger
releases.summary:
While your wife is away on a trip, you stumble across a mysterious betting app that promises instant riches - all from the comfort of your home. Desperate for a way out of financial ruin, you start spinning. But this game isn’t just about money. It’s about survival.

Treasure Tiger is a first-person horror game where every spin brings you closer to fortune... or to something far worse.

Your only tool is your phone - and the cursed roulette app installed on it. Use the mouse to spin and earn cash through randomized outcomes. Each result affects your surroundings. Power outages. Sudden darkness. Unnatural sounds. And the Tiger... getting closer.

Will you get rich - or get devoured?

releases.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
releases.summary:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!

releases.name: BOARDING DENIED
releases.summary: The world ends in 12 days. Your rubber stamp decides who leaves it.November 2041. The meteorite Wormwood will strike Earth in 12 days, and the last evacuation ships are boarding. In BOARDING DENIED you are the clerk at Boarding Window 7: check every ticket, identity card, medical certificate and professional record, then stamp BOARD or DENIED. Every stamp is a life.Seats are limited, the rules change every day, and the people in line will beg, bribe and threaten to get past you.CHECK EVERY DOCUMENTCompare tickets, identity cards, medical certificates and professional records. The Geiger counter, thermometer, analysis syringe and scanner reveal what the paperwork hides.12 DAYS, 12 SHIPSEvery day brings a different ship with its own destination and rules: a farming colony on Mars, a science vault, a cult ship, a corporate luxury cruise, a hospital ship, a lottery ship, an ark of children bound for Titan, and 'La Última'.THE LINE BEGS, BRIBES, THREATENSPeople plead, slip you money and make threats at your window. Blackmail and corruption seep out of Window 6. Who do you believe, and what will you accept?A FAMILY TO FEEDEvery night, pay for food, medicine and heating for your family, or save up to buy them a seat. Correct calls earn money, and mistakes bring fines.STORIES THAT CROSSA doctor who sells forged certificates, a journalist hunting the lists, twins with a secret: recurring characters whose stories cross from day to day. Several endings depend on who you let board.RUST AND BONEDirty, detailed apocalyptic pixel art, living characters with something unsettling about them, ash falling in the final days, menus built from forms and stamps, and an original synthesized soundtrack.Tense, moral and darkly funny, BOARDING DENIED is bureaucratic black humor at the end of the world.Who gets a seat, and who stays behind to watch the sky?

releases.name: Hunter's Moon
releases.summary:
Hunter’s Moon is a first-person historical narrative folk-horror set over the course of one fateful night. Meet mummers dressed in folk costumes, evade capture by the witch hunters, and eavesdrop on a characterful cast of regular folk worn down by war and misfortune. Discover the secrets of this dysfunctional village on the brink as you embody an accused “witch” on the run for her life.

You play as Lilith Thorne, an accused woman who must flee through a 17th-century rural village and its surrounding forests and moors in search of safety. As she is stalked and hunted by the Witchfinder General, the village magistrate, and a local huntsman, you must use stealth and cunning to evade capture. And by eavesdropping at windows, you may gain knowledge and aid that can help her survive the night.

releases.name: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
releases.summary:
The Inverted World was once a harmonious place where good and evil coexisted, maintained by Tas, the Absolute. But now, darkness threatens to engulf everything, and Ayasa must embark on a perilous journey through the devastated lands of Faith, Hope, Love, Greed, Indifference, and Betrayal. Only by finding the remnants of Tas’s light can Ayasa hope to restore balance and save the world from complete destruction.

Step into the eerie world of Ayasa, a platformer that blends quests, horror, and puzzles into a thrilling adventure. Navigate six lands corrupted by darkness and restore balance by uncovering the light left behind. With its rich atmosphere and unique gameplay, Ayasa challenges you to survive a world full of danger, mystery and wonder.

releases.name: Fangtopia
releases.summary: Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

releases.name: Rusty Rangers
releases.summary: No one remembers what the world looked like before, except for a team of brave rangers. Now chaos and unpredictability reign everywhere - harmless creatures in the past bring destruction, and the world around is constantly changing, over and over again nullifying the familiar environment around.

releases.name: Dominoes Together
releases.summary: Dominoes Together brings the classic game of dominoes to PlayStation®5 – free to play, online and made for playing with others.Take a seat at the table with up to four players, match the ends, block your opponents and be the first to play all your tiles.• Free to play – jump in and start playing right away.• Online multiplayer for up to 4 players – challenge players from around the world.• No waiting for a full table – bots fill any empty seats.• Climb the leaderboard – win matches and prove you rule the table.• Make it yours – customize your character, tiles and table.• Easy to learn, hard to master – simple rules with plenty of room for strategy.

releases.name: Shoresy: Legends of the North
releases.summary: Shoresy: Legends of the North brings the hit TV comedy series Shoresy (Hulu, Crave, Netflix, SBS) to life with a modern take on classic hockey video games. Enjoy fast-paced Sudbury Blueberry Bulldog hockey gameplay with hits, goals, fights, chirps and more.

releases.name: Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch Story: COMBAT
releases.summary:
Syega are powerful crystals that grant humans the ability to use magic. Some crystals are so powerful they have to be contained in specially prepared vessels; these are known as Magic Items. Join intrepid adventurer Al as she explores the dangerous labyrinths of Belfer Island in search of powerful Magic Items. Along the way Al will join forces with strong allies and face even stronger enemies. Can Al conquer the imposing dungeon known as Godshill and find the ultimate Magic Item?

Brave Dungeon is a dungeon crawling RPG adventure by indie games company INSIDE SYSTEM, creators of the Legend of Dark Witch series. Brave Dungeon features an easy to pick up combat system for new players. However, it also has many customization options, unique playable characters, and deep challenges for the completionist. A crafting system featuring materials dropped from enemies and treasure chests in dungeons allows you to customize your characters further. Class Changes allow the player to build their party the way they want, playing to one's own personal preferences and their characters' unique strengths.

[Dark Witch's Story:COMBAT]

Dark Witch's Story: COMBAT is a battle game where you use cards featuring characters and creatures from the Dark Witch series. The players pick 3 cards to use against each other in a best out of 3 battle. The players also gets to use Magic Items to give to their cards, which can drastically turn the tides of the battle. There are 2 different modes available, Quest mode for single-player and Battle mode for multi-player. When you play Quest mode you will win new, and stronger cards for you to use, while aiming for the title of "Game Master". [Nintendo]

releases.name: The Walking Trade
releases.summary:
The Walking Trade is a quirky, action-packed zombie apocalypse store management game where chaos and commerce collide!

Design your shop, balancing space, aesthetics, and functionality. Organize shelves, set prices, and ensure customers leave happy - or at least alive.

Customers aren’t your only problem - zombies invade! Wield melee weapons, firearms, or whatever you can find to defend your shop during raids and hordes.

Hire survivors to scavenge supplies, serve customers, or guard the shop. Keep them equipped and motivated to reap the rewards.

releases.name: Shardwatch Dominion
releases.summary:
Shardwatch Dominion is a classic top-down tower defense game set in circular arenas. You protect a central fortress and its glowing crystals from waves of enemies that attack from every direction.

Every decision matters: where you build, what you spend crystals on, and which upgrades you take between waves. Placement and resource management decide whether the fortress holds.

releases.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
releases.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

releases.name: House 2
releases.summary:
As a terrible storm rages on, Tabby finds herself once again trapped in a never-ending nightmare.

Uncover the mystery of the curse or succumb to it in the sequel to the 2020 horror game, House.

releases.name: Darkenstein 3D Director's Cut
releases.summary:
Inspired by the breakneck pace of the glory days of late-'90s shooters, you play as a hobo trying to rescue his dog from the clutches of the Nazis.

Fast, brutal, and demanding. Darkenstein 3D doesn’t make it easy for you. You can dodge enemy projectiles, but surviving requires quick movements, precise aim, and sharp reflexes. Every battle is a deadly dance of dodges and spins. No cover, no aim assist—just pure, unadulterated action.

Conquer 13 hand-designed levels that progressively increase in difficulty. Explore castles, caves, valleys, and desert villages. Unlock doors with hidden keys, uncover secrets, hunt for treasure, and keep racking up higher and higher scores.

The game features 23 types of enemies spread across various factions. Gory explosions, ragdoll physics, and shootouts filled with debris: every shot feels impactful, and every death looks painful. Enemies fly, disintegrate, and crumble in a glorious bloodbath as the battlefield collapses around you.
Kill the Nazis, take down Hitler, and rescue your dog.

Features :
* Frenetic combat with a classic arsenal: shotguns, machine guns, rocket launchers, grenades, and mines.
* Level design packed with secrets, hidden keys, optional areas, and alternate routes that reward meticulous exploration.
* An animal companion: a trained rat that distracts enemies or triggers traps, adding a unique and strategic element.
* An industrial-style soundtrack with heavy electronic rhythms, perfectly synchronized with the intensity of the combat.
* Voiced by professional voice actors

releases.name: Carry The Glass
releases.summary:
As two construction workers, you are transporting a glass window for a skyscraper. On this journey you have to be careful with the glass because it is very fragile. 

Can you make it to the top of the skyscraper without breaking it?

Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer! Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges. Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles.

releases.name: Neon GT Racing
releases.summary: Neon GT Racing throws you onto neon-lit circuits at full throttle. Pick your GT car, nail the racing line, and fight your way from the back of the grid to the top of the podium.Your rivals never make it easy. They overtake, dodge obstacles, and bounce straight back from every crash, so each lap stays tight until the checkered flag.Drive it your way: arcade handling for instant drift-and-go thrills, or realistic handling where every braking point counts.FeaturesPowerful GT cars with sharp, responsive handlingNeon-lit tracks with real-time reflectionsAggressive AI rivals that overtake and recover from crashesArcade or realistic driving stylesMulti-lap races against a full gridInstant respawn to keep you in the action

releases.name: Blossom Voyage
releases.summary:
In Blossom Voyage, players assume the first-person perspective of a frustrated young professional who, driven by unwillingness, embarks on a solo journey to Japan after career setbacks. From the moment they board the plane, anticipation and immersion are fully ignited, launching a new chapter filled with challenges and possibilities. 

Blossom Voyage is a unique live-action interactive video game. With a romantic theme, it features simple gameplay, an engaging storyline, and a clear main plot. Players will meet five heroines with distinct personalities and backgrounds. By making different interactive choices and participating in casual mini-games/challenges, they can unlock various story branches, experiencing the complete journey from meeting to falling in love, and finally achieving exclusive romantic endings.

releases.name: FIRE AND ASHES
releases.summary:
FIRE AND ASHES is the first survival horror game to feature speech interaction with AI. The game features elements of action, melee combat, survival, shooting, and puzzles that ask the player to use strategy and logical thinking. 

Taking place in 1977 in the Paul Staderbeiger Psychiatric Hospital, the plot revolves around Henry, his struggle with the ghosts of the past, and the pain of his loss and grief. 

Prepare for a journey beyond your imagining!
